title: Line sketch: Fiery Sky of Chaos
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A turbulent celestial scene dominated by swirling fiery clouds in explosive and around a radiant central sun, with a large orb glowing on the left. Dynamic composition features dramatic light rays, dark billowing forms, and contrasting sky areas. Bold painterly technique with intense color gradients and luminous highlights creates a sense of movement and drama (derived from painting #80).
